name: Low Ceiling
concept: The ceiling is the instrument: a grid of light batons breathes, presses down on the crowd, then lets go.
object: 48 kinetic pixel batons hung in a 6 x 8 grid over the whole room
photoMoment: The batons dropped to just above raised hands, all red, the artist on the crowd riser with the grid sloping toward her.

elements.note: Low riser in the crowd, reached by steps off the deck.
48 batons, 6 rows (X) x 8 columns (Y), each 2.4 m pixel tube on its own winch. Moves as waves.
Small, low upstage strip; texture only.
8 floor wash/beam fixtures along the deck edge, uplighting the batons.

acts.name: Hum
acts.state: Batons flat at 4.4 m, barely glowing.
acts.light: Ice blue, key light only on the artist.

acts.name: Breathing
acts.state: Batons ripple in waves from the stage to the back wall, one row per beat.
acts.light: Ice with paper-white peaks on the downbeat.

acts.name: Pressure
acts.state: Batons drop to 2.6 m and tilt toward the stage; the artist moves to the crowd riser.
acts.light: Riot red, room strobes on the snare.

acts.name: Release
acts.state: Batons snap back to 4.4 m; CO2 and confetti.
acts.light: Full paper white, then blackout on the last word.

buildNotes: Ceiling 5 m, so batons never go below 2.6 m over the floor. In-game: 48 instanced meshes, one material instance, wave motion driven by a curve on the cue clock. No flames indoors.
